details.method: Persist scoped binding, design confirmation and acceptance before reporting success or dispatch; verify the exact section/key through a fresh disk reader. Preserve old cached authority on failed save. Recover missing authority only by an explicit original-owner confirmation, without replaying workers or clearing failures.
details.when: An editor keeps authoritative task or design state in a lazily saved metadata cache separately from chat history and must survive interrupted shutdown.
details.counterexample: A graceful shutdown can flush the cache and hide the defect; reading the same cache is not persistence evidence. Stop becoming idle does not prove terminal reporting finished. A read failure before save does not test save-failure rollback. Physical power-loss durability needs separate storage guarantees.
details.trial_plan: On a future integrated installed candidate, bind through the ordinary public requirement entry, force-kill the direct editor before graceful shutdown, and cold-read the same parent binding. Reconfirm a missing exact original approval without dispatch, inject readable read-only metadata during the confirmation dialog, and require actual save failure with unchanged disk/cache/children; separately reject conflict, foreign/live/stale ownership. Record a new prospective result before considering verification.
